Clippie macOS FFmpeg/Homebrew source-input collection — review candidate

The archive contains FFmpeg 8.0.1, both Homebrew formula patches, and the eight codec/library source inputs recorded by the build manifest: dav1d, lame, libvpx, OpenSSL, Opus, SVT-AV1, x264 and x265. The SHA256SUMS file hashes every other archive member. Source archive hashes are pinned to the installed Homebrew formulae; x264 is generated from the pinned Git commit and tree. The SVT FFmpeg patch was reconstructed from the stated FFmpeg commit with Git format-patch, and its bytes match the exact formula hash. See collection.json, source-pins.json and reconstruct_ffmpeg_svt_patch.sh for provenance.

The installed formulae, receipts, available SBOMs, installed license candidates, app build manifest, FFmpeg build configuration, and current package_macos.py are provided as build/relink investigation evidence. Lame's installed SBOM is absent. The package_macos.py snapshot is current source, not independent proof it was used for the older binary. Reproducing the build requires the appropriate Homebrew environment, toolchain and any applicable build inputs; this archive does not by itself demonstrate a reproducible build or satisfy every corresponding-source, relinking or distribution obligation.

Other native Python/ML/runtime components, fonts, model terms, license compatibility, complete notices and actual recipient delivery remain separate review items. This collection is not legal clearance or a representation of complete corresponding source. An unsuccessful HTML response is excluded from this archive and remains in the local collection as a partial.
